args.command:
node server.js & sleep 1
# add a book
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "add: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -d "title=Dune&author=Frank Herbert" http://localhost:3000/books
# home page lists it
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'href="/books/[a-z0-9-]*"' | head -1
ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '/books/[a-z0-9-]*' | head -1 | cut -d/ -f3)
# detail page + share link
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o 'http://localhost:3000/books/[a-z0-9-]*' | head -1
# save notes
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "notes: %{http_code}\n" --data-urlencode "notes=Spice must flow." http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/notes
# mark finished
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish: %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish
# notes survive + status changed
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o 'Spice must flow.\|Finished [0-9-]*'
cat data/books.json
# 404 check
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "404: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/nope

ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '/books/[a-z0-9-]*' | head -1 | cut -d/ -f3)
# detail page + share link
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o 'http://localhost:3000/books/[a-z0-9-]*' | head -1
# save notes
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "notes: %{http_code}\n" --data-urlencode "notes=Spice must flow." http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/notes
# mark finished
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish: %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish
# notes survive + status changed
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o 'Spice must flow.\|Finished [0-9-]*'
cat data/books.json
# 404 check
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "404: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/books/nope
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 0.5; node server.js & sleep 1; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "Dune\|Finished"; pkill -f "node server.js"

pkill -f "node server.js" || true; sleep 0.5
nohup node server.js > /tmp/books.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oE "Dune|Finished"
kill %1

nohup node server.js > /tmp/books.log 2>&1 & sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -oE "Dune|Finished"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/862521f4 | grep -c "Spice must flow"
pkill -x node; cat /tmp/books.log
